question: Tambaya
defaultDirections: Zaɓi amsar da kake ganin ta amsa tambayar. Idan ka gama, danna {checkAnswer}. Za ka sami ra'ayi da ke nuna ko amsarka daidai ce da yadda za ka ci gaba.
relatedContentDescription: Wannan yana ƙirƙirar wuri a naɗe don abun ciki mai alaƙa da wannan tambaya kuma ana nuna shi koyaushe
hintDescription: Ana nuna wannan idan mai amfani ya yi kuskure
evidenceDescription: Ana nuna wannan idan mai amfani ya yi daidai
numericDirections: Rubuta lamba. Ana nuna maka ma'auni. Idan ka gama, zaɓi {checkAnswer}.
withinPercent: Amsoshin da ke cikin {tolerance}% na ainihin ƙima ana ƙirga su.
withinAbsolute: Amsoshin da ke cikin {tolerance} na ainihin ƙima ana ƙirga su.

notSetUp: Ba a saita amsa don wannan tambaya ba tukuna.
authorViewTitle: Maɓallin amsa (marubuta kawai ke ganin wannan)
formulaHelp: Lamba, ko dabarar da ke amfani da masu canji da ke ƙasa, misali d / (t / 60). Dabaru za su iya amfani da + - * / ^, baka, sqrt() da abs().
tokensHelp: Nuna mai canji a cikin tambayar ta hanyar rubuta sunansa a cikin baka mai lanƙwasa, misali {d}.
keyProblem: Ba za a iya lissafa wannan ba tukuna. Tabbatar cewa kowane suna a cikin dabarar mai canji ne.
